messages:
Nina: Heads-up — CRM sweep scheduled tonight; concern: playbook triggers on stale account_owner fields and duplicates will re-fire. Need gating.
Rob: Can we add an owner stability window? Suggest only run playbook if owner_claimed_at <= now() - interval '14 days' as a quick gate.
Sam: Also strong need for ingestion dedupe by account_id + contact_digest. Quick check: ```SELECT account_id, count(*) FROM playbook_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY account_id HAVING count(*) > 1;```
Elena: If we only gate by owner age we'll miss lots of unclaimed accounts. Propose: tiered flow — claimed owners get automated playbook, unclaimed accounts land in a batch-assign queue for CS ops.
Nina: Proposed rollout: 1) dedupe at ingest (key=account_id|contact_digest) 2) owner-stability window = 14d 3) unclaimed -> batch-assign job + sample export 4) dry-run on staging + CSV to #cs-ops for manual review.
Rob: I can ship the dedupe + dry-run toggle tonight.
Sam: I'll add the batch-assign (low-priority queue) and prepare a 1k-account sample export.
CS Bot: Dry-run scheduled on staging for crm-sweep-2833333000. Estimated matches = 1,032. No outbound sends. run_id=stg-2833333000 :robot_face:
Elena: Please add a dashboard card for "Unclaimed queue size" and "weekly outreach delta" so Enablement/PS can monitor.
Nina: Will draft the rollout checklist and tag Rob/Sam. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
